Changes.LogName: Jodi: extra everyday dialogue, opening-up phase

Entries.spring_Tue6: I tried making a proper breakfast instead of eating whatever was left in the pan.$h#$b#It was nice to sit down before the day got away from me. I should do that more often.
Entries.spring_Sun4: I stopped by the chapel this morning. It's peaceful there before everyone starts talking.#$e#Sometimes a little quiet is all I need.
Entries.summer_Wed4: The garden is growing faster than I can keep up with it.#$b#I used to think a bigger garden meant more freedom. Funny how that works.
Entries.summer_Thu6: I made a list of things I'd like to do this summer. The first item is 'one afternoon with absolutely no chores'.$h#$b#I haven't crossed it off yet.
Entries.summer_Sun4: The boys used to spend Sundays racing around the house. Now Sam sleeps in and Vincent wants to be outside all day.#$e#I miss the noise sometimes. Not all the noise, mind you.
Entries.fall_Tue6: Caroline says I should try a new exercise routine. I told her my current routine is chasing laundry around the house.$h#$b#She didn't think that was very funny.
Entries.fall_Fri4: The air smells like somebody's baking a pie. Now I'm thinking about dessert instead of the errands I still have to run.$h
Entries.fall_Sun8: I was looking through old photographs today. I hardly recognized the girl in some of them.$s#$b#I don't dislike the woman I've become. I just wish I'd made a little more room for her along the way.
Entries.winter_Tue4: I used to build the biggest snow forts in the neighborhood. My mother said I treated every snowfall like a personal invitation.$h#$e#I wonder if I could still manage one.
Entries.winter_Thu6: My back has been behaving today. I'm trying not to celebrate too early.$h#$b#Harvey says I should listen to my body. I suppose he has a point.
Entries.winter_Fri4: I've always wanted to travel somewhere warm in the middle of winter. Just once, I'd like to wake up and not have to find my gloves.
Entries.winter_Sun8: I wonder what I'd do with a whole week to myself. No shopping lists, no laundry, no one asking what's for dinner...#$b#I think I'd need a day just to decide.

Changes.LogName: Jodi: extra everyday dialogue, pulling-away phase

Entries.spring_Thu8: I almost told Caroline about you yesterday. Then I changed the subject and asked about her tea plants.$s#$b#She's going to notice eventually. She notices everything.
Entries.spring_Sat8: I keep telling myself to be sensible. Then I remember how happy I felt talking to you, and sensible starts to sound terribly lonely.$s
Entries.spring_Sun8: I went to the chapel and tried to sort out my thoughts. I came home with more questions than I left with.$s#$b#I suppose that's still something.
Entries.summer_Tue8: I saw a couple dancing in the town square. I used to love dancing.$s#$b#I can't decide whether I miss the dancing or just being looked at like that.
Entries.summer_Thu8: I keep making excuses to stay busy. A clean counter, folded towels, another errand...#$b#It's easier to finish a task than to admit I'm frightened of what I want.
Entries.summer_Fri8: Caroline asked why I've been so distracted. I told her it was the heat.$s#$b#She raised one eyebrow. I don't think she believed me.
Entries.summer_Sun8: I sat outside for an hour and didn't do a single useful thing.$s#$b#It felt wonderful for five minutes. Then I felt guilty for the next fifty-five.
Entries.fall_Wed8: I found an old recipe card with my handwriting on it. I used to write little notes in the margins about who liked each dish.$s#$b#I wonder when I stopped writing things just because they made me happy.
Entries.fall_Fri8: Sometimes I catch myself planning a future, and then I shut the thought away before it can become real.$s#$b#I'm trying to understand why hope feels so dangerous.
Entries.fall_Sun8: I don't want you to think I'm asking you to fix my life. I have to do that part myself.$s#$b#I just wish I could let someone stand beside me while I try.
Entries.winter_Mon8: I passed a shop window and saw my reflection. For once I didn't count the lines around my eyes.$s#$b#I wondered what I might look like if I weren't always judging myself.
Entries.winter_Thu8: I miss being carefree. I also know I can't go back and become that girl again.$s#$b#Maybe I need to find out what a happy woman looks like now.
Entries.winter_Sat8: I wanted to knock on your door today. I even had my hand raised.$s#$b#Then I remembered I don't know how to accept something good without waiting for it to disappear.
Entries.winter_Sun8: I think I've spent so long being afraid of making the wrong choice that I've forgotten I can make a choice for myself.$s#$b#That thought is both wonderful and terrifying.

Changes.LogName: Jodi: extra everyday dialogue, devoted phase

Entries.spring_Tue10: I bought a little notebook for things I want us to do together. The first page is already full.$h#$b#Don't worry, I left room for your ideas. A little room.
Entries.spring_Thu10: I told Caroline that I'm happy. She smiled before I even finished the sentence.$l#$b#I think she's been waiting a long time to hear me say it.
Entries.spring_Sun10: I went to the chapel this morning and gave thanks for the life I'm building, not the one I thought I was supposed to have.$l#$b#That felt like an important difference.
Entries.summer_Mon10: I have a confession, @. I sometimes take the long way home just because it gives me another minute to think about seeing you.$h#$e#I'm not sorry.
Entries.summer_Wed10: Let's leave the housework for tomorrow and go somewhere. The beach, the mountains, anywhere.$l#$b#I want some memories that don't involve a shopping list.
Entries.summer_Sat10: I wore my favorite dress today. Not for a festival or a special occasion. I just felt like looking pretty.$h#$b#You noticed, didn't you?
Entries.summer_Sun10: I used to dream about taking a vacation and then immediately think of all the reasons I couldn't go.$l#$b#Now I'm thinking about where we should go first.
Entries.fall_Tue10: Caroline asked whether I've been sleeping better. I told her yes, and she gave me that knowing smile again.$h#$b#I think I'll have to start inventing new answers.
Entries.fall_Thu10: I made rhubarb pie today. The first slice is yours, naturally.$h#$b#The second is also yours, but only if you say something nice about the crust.
Entries.fall_Sun10: I don't want to spend the rest of my life only remembering what I missed.$l#$b#There's so much I still want to do, and I'd like to do it with you.
Entries.winter_Mon10: I used to dread quiet evenings. Now I look forward to them because I get to share one with you.$l
Entries.winter_Wed10: I caught my reflection in the window and smiled at the woman looking back.$h#$b#She seems a little braver than she used to be.
Entries.winter_Sat10: Come sit with me. I have a blanket, hot chocolate, and absolutely no intention of being productive tonight.$h#$e#You can help with the hot chocolate. That's your one job.
Entries.winter_Sun10: I want us to keep making plans, even silly ones. A garden bench, a trip to the coast, a bigger dinner table...#$b#A life should have things to look forward to.$l

Changes.LogName: Jodi: extra marriage dialogue, pulling-away phase

Entries.Good_5: I made your favorite breakfast. I know you don't need me to prove I belong here...#$b#I'm still learning how to believe that myself.$s
Entries.Good_6: Could we take a walk together later? I want to talk about something, but I think I'd rather do it somewhere quiet.$s
Entries.Good_7: Caroline told me to stop apologizing every time I ask for a little affection.$6#$b#I'm trying. So... may I have a hug?
Entries.Good_8: Sometimes I still wake up expecting to be alone. Then I remember where I am.$s#$b#It takes me a moment, but I'm getting better.
Entries.Good_9: I want to be a good wife to you, but I don't want to turn it into another list of chores.$s#$b#Maybe tonight we can just be together.
Entries.Rainy_Night_5: The rain has been going for hours. Would you mind staying close tonight? I feel calmer when I can hear you breathing.$s
Entries.NoBed_0: I think we misplaced our bed... or the house did. Let's find somewhere comfortable and try not to make a fuss.$6
Entries.NoBed_1: Well, this is inconvenient. I suppose we can improvise for one night.$s#$b#I'm trying to be cheerful about it. How am I doing?
Entries.NoBed_2: I can't find our bed. I checked twice.$s#$b#Perhaps I should stop worrying and sit with you for a while.
Entries.NoBed_3: No bed tonight? That's alright. I could use a little time to talk before we sleep.$s
Entries.funLeave_Jodi: I'm going to see Caroline for a while. She said I should get out of the house and stop thinking so much.$s
Entries.funReturn_Jodi: Caroline says I should be kinder to myself. I told her I'd try.$s#$b#She said she'd believe it when she sees it.

Changes.LogName: Jodi: extra marriage dialogue, devoted phase

Entries.Good_5: I left a little note in your pocket. It says something very important. ...It says I love you.$l#$b#I didn't want you to go a whole day without knowing.
Entries.Good_6: I want to learn something new with you. Dancing, fishing, even a language. Though I reserve the right to be terrible at it.$h
Entries.Rainy_Night_5: Come here, love. The rain can have the whole valley tonight. I only want this warm little corner with you.$l
Entries.NoBed_0: Our bed has vanished! Well, that's one way to make an ordinary evening interesting.$h#$b#Come sit with me while we figure it out.
Entries.NoBed_1: No bed? Then I suppose we'll have to stay up talking. I can think of worse problems.$l
Entries.NoBed_2: I checked every room. Not a bed in sight.$h#$b#Maybe the house is telling us to have a late-night picnic.
Entries.NoBed_3: I was hoping for a cozy night beside you. We can manage that without a bed, can't we?$l
Entries.funLeave_Jodi: I'm off to visit Caroline. We're going to catch up, laugh too loudly, and probably eat more cookies than we should.$h
Entries.funReturn_Jodi: Caroline sends her love. She also says I should stop bragging about you. I told her that's an unreasonable request.$l
